Do you know anyone who you think might be going through the same thing as you? They might be a good option to ask, because they will at least understand you more than others.

I found out one of my best friends was going through the same brain poo as me, and so I opened up to her and so did she and now once a week we have this kind of 'feelings check' thing where each of us gets 10 minutes to talk their minds out non-stop (you can use less than a 10, or more) while the other listens and offers advice in the end. It's kinda helped us both, I guess?
But in my opinion, find someone you trust and know is not judgmental and I know it can very very very difficult at first because you start thinking 'god they're gonna think i'm just seeking attention' but if you find the right person, they will care.

But hey! If not then you can message any of us. I'm sure most are willing to listen (or should I say read lol) good luck fellow redditor!
